evidence.title: Replicas
evidence.finding: Cloud Linux workspaces accept external task triggers and produce visual outputs.

evidence.title: Replicas docs
evidence.finding: Current harness inventory and Git review integration.

evidence.title: Replicas pricing
evidence.finding: Full and Flex seat pricing differs from automation billing.

evidence.title: Billing
evidence.finding: At least one Full seat is required. Awake workspace minutes aggregate; automated use bills separately.

evidence.title: Replicas Workspaces
evidence.locator: Tools; chats; collaboration; sleep and archive
evidence.finding: Per-workspace Linux VM; multiple harness chats; queued/steering messages; shared workspaces; file editor/diffs/inline comments, Linux desktop, terminal, Docker and Canvas. Sleep after 30 minutes inactivity, message wakes/restores; retention/deletion deadlines apply.

evidence.title: Replicas Motherships
evidence.finding: Long-lived orchestrator delegates separate-VM ships, sends messages and receives results, tracks ships/PRs/Linear/blockers/decisions. Cap20 unarchived ships; ships cannot spawn ships; unavailable in Cursor chats. Shared teammates run it together.

evidence.title: Replicas Automations
evidence.finding: Saved prompts run on schedules or GitHub/GitLab/Slack/Sentry/Linear/custom webhooks. Fresh or reused workspace, debounce and successful-run limit; delete/archive/sleep policies; delete waits for background work.

evidence.title: Replicas Desktop app
evidence.finding: macOS12 Intel/Arm, Windows10+ and Linux AppImage/deb x64/Arm. Native window wraps hosted deployment; mac notifications/screenshots; experimental local port forwarding.

evidence.title: Replicas iOS app
evidence.finding: Native iOS starts cloud tasks and queues followups, reviews changes/checks/Canvas. Cloud work continues when app closes; no file browser/Code/Desktop tab. Consent before AI data sharing.

evidence.title: Replicas Team
evidence.finding: Admin/Member/custom roles with additive All members grants; environment/automation Read/Write and analytics Read. Removed users immediately lose organization workspaces.

evidence.title: Replicas Billing
evidence.finding: Developer$50/month includes$50 usage; Team$200+ in$100 steps, seats do not change bill. $100 trial credit no card/no time limit; exhausted trial blocked until paid. Compute rates, monthly rollover reset, daily overage invoices and hard usage limit documented.

evidence.title: Replicas Security policies
evidence.finding: Require Replicas/code-host identity and PR user attribution; block agent PR/MR merges and default protected branch pushes.

evidence.title: Replicas Data retention
evidence.finding: History setting retains chat/Canvas asleep/archived when enabled, awake-only when disabled; repository files separate. Available trial/Team/Enterprise, not Developer.

evidence.title: Replicas Review
evidence.finding: PR/MR queue, guided tour ordered diffs, agent review chat, inline comments/review/agent-fix options; approve/request changes/merge subject to repository rules.

evidence.title: Replicas Learnings
